Thanks Soojin — quick notes from marketplace ops:

1) AWS listing: StratusSoft will be billed via AWS Marketplace (metered SaaS). For procurement we need to give them two routing options:
   - Marketplace-purchase (preferred): Customers buy through AWS and we reconcile via AWS invoices. PO should reference our AWS Seller ID and the AWS order id.
   - Direct contract (rare): for customers who require Redwood invoice directly; requires a minimal SOW + finance onboarding.

2) For first-pass, ask StratusSoft to use the Marketplace-purchase lane. That avoids direct invoices and is faster for go-live.

3) SOC2 / security evidence: We can point them to our evidence binder (redacted) and provide the marketplace-specific data handling note. If they insist, legal will handle an NDA/one-off attestation.

I’m attaching our standard AWS_Marketplace_SLA.docx and a short snippet we can paste into the onboarding packet.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
